retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus, high-key portrait with a hazy pink-to-lavender gradient and elegant, looping script typography.
excludeWhen: sharp modern high-contrast lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure in flowing, translucent white and pink garments emerges from a dense, warm-toned haze. The image features a heavy grain and soft-focus glow typical of 1970s analog photography, with a color palette dominated by dusty rose, lavender, and cream.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with arms outstretched creating a triangular silhouette
Text elements framing the subject's head and upper right shoulder
Soft-focus background blending seamlessly with the subject's translucent clothing
Warm, high-key lighting creating a halo effect around the hair
coreInvariants: Low contrast in the midtones for a 'dreamy' effect

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait centered, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, looking upward and slightly away from the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left title, move to the subject's face, then follow the cascading text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample hazy space around the subject, particularly at the bottom and sides, creating an airy feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dusty rose and peach (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value; colors are pastel and muted rather than vibrant.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with high-ascenders and decorative loops
letterConstructionRules: Large, circular flourishes on capital letters
Thin, elegant weight with consistent stroke width
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'T' and 'A' feature exaggerated, sweeping loops
Lowercase 'r' and 'e' have soft, rounded terminals

composition.position: Top edge and upper right quadrant
composition.relationshipToImage: Floating on top of the haze

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script font used in varying sizes and staggered positions to create rhythm.
graphicDevices: Staggered text alignment to suggest movement

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the formal yet flowing loop structures
Provides the elegant, monolinear cursive look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s style portrait of a woman with flowing hair and sheer white clothing, set against a hazy pink and peach gradient background with heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lavender-colored script text at the top and staggered down the right side, using a font with elegant loops and flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key and hazy?
Is the typography a consistent lavender script?
Does the subject have a soft-focus glow?
Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text color is specifically lavender/muted purple.
Verify the subject's clothing appears translucent and layered.
Check that the grain doesn't obscure facial features excessively.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the staggered text.
